provenance_note: All client/vendor/human/address/copy data excluded; vertical retained; copy structure only.

program_model.instance_model: photopolymer ADA room/office/suite IDs; some integrate Apco Notifier paper-insert holder

knowledge.plain_language_summary: ADA tactile IDs: painted photopolymer panels with 1/32in raised copy (silkscreened white) and integral Grade-2 braille; suite IDs add an Apco Notifier page holder for changeable paper occupant lists.
knowledge.rationale: Photopolymer integral tactile+braille is the compliant standard; the Notifier holds volatile occupant data as paper so the fabrication stays fixed.

structure.construction: 0.0625-0.125in photopolymer, painted face+returns, raised 1/32in copy silkscreened white, integral Grade-2 braille; Apco Notifier custom-painted page holder + acrylic insert pocket (suite variant); 3M VHB

compliance.notes: Integral photopolymer raised copy + Grade-2 braille; ANSI A117.

craft_observations: Photopolymer integral tactile+braille; Apco Notifier paper insert for volatile occupant data.
